items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: He wasn't with Fats, was he?

ctx.x: But what band was he with?
He wasn't with Fats, was he?
No. I don't think so. And he wasn't -- it wasn't Basie. I have a feeling he was with Fletcher. Smack. I think he was. In the later years, you know.
